yt.title: Unix time hits 2,000,000,000 seconds on {c_date} (UTC) #Shorts
yt.description:
Unix time counts seconds since January 1, 1970 UTC. Python: datetime.fromtimestamp(2,000,000,000, UTC) = {c_date}, {c_time}. It passed 1,000,000,000 on {c_1e9}.
Narration is AI-generated.

scenes.narration: Many computers keep time as one big number: the seconds since January first, nineteen seventy.

scenes.label: the day that count reaches 2,000,000,000
scenes.narration: That count reaches two billion on {c_date_say}, at {c_time_say}.

It passed one billion on {c_1e9_say}. Two billion is still below the thirty two bit limit of about two point one four billion, so it fits. The real trouble is twenty thirty-eight, when that limit runs out.
Mark the date. Where will you be when the clock hits two billion?
